description:
Left temporal subcortical well-defined space-occupying lesion. It shows a central cystic component and a peripheral solid component showing diffusion restriction and contrast enhancement. The lesion is surrounded by vasogenic edema and exerts a positive mass effect. MRS showed a markedly elevated Choline peak and Cho/Cr ratio.

Left temporal craniotomy and left temporal small cortical hemorrhagic enhancing area, post interventional sequel.

Differential possibilities for this case (in this young age group) include a PXA, ganglioglioma, supratentorial ependymoma or less likely pediatric high-grade glioma.
